card.architecture: Krea 2 Turbo (8-step distilled; Qwen3-VL 4B encoder, Qwen-Image/Wan2.1 VAE), whole-image partial-denoise img2img polish
card.summary: Polish any existing image through Krea 2 Turbo — the source is VAE-encoded to the init latent and re-sampled at a partial denoise with NO mask, so the composition is kept while Turbo reworks texture and applies Krea's aesthetic. This is the 'Turbo polish' stage of Krea 2 (Base + Turbo Polish), but fed an image from ANY model instead of a Krea base render. Single pass, single weight.
use_cases: apply Krea's polished aesthetic to an image another model generated
clean up texture / micro-detail without changing composition
cheap single-pass finishing on an existing render
card.commercial_use: open weights — verify the Krea 2 license for your use
card.pick_when: You have an image from another model and want Krea 2's look applied over it, keeping the composition. Use Krea 2 (Base + Turbo Polish) instead when you are generating from scratch.

prompt.guidance: Describe the image you are polishing in natural language — style, lighting, and mood words carry the most weight. Lower 'Polish strength' to stay close to the source; raise it to let Turbo redraw more (and drift toward the prompt).
prompt.example: an editorial photograph of a ceramic vase on a sunlit table, soft film grain, muted earth tones, shallow depth of field
prompt.instructions: Write natural language describing the target look. Distilled Turbo: 8 steps, no CFG (cfg 1), euler/simple. 'Polish strength' (denoise) ~0.25-0.4 polishes texture while keeping the source composition; higher redraws more. No negative prompts (cfg 1). The source is sampled at its own resolution — Krea 2 is native at ~1K and holds up to 2K.
do: Keep Polish strength low (~0.25-0.4) to preserve the source
Keep it to 8 steps — more won't help
dont: Push Polish strength near 0.9 unless you want the source largely redrawn
prompt.negative_guidance: Not supported (distilled, cfg 1); describe what you want.

negative.note: Distilled few-step (cfg 1 / guidance 0); negatives don't work.

speed.note: Single 8-step Turbo pass at partial denoise (fewer sigma steps than a full render); the fp8 encoder offloads before the diffusion model loads.
speed.measured_note: Not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Send an image + a prompt describing the look; the whole frame is polished through Krea 2 Turbo. 'Polish strength' controls how far it drifts from the source.
ui_help.good_for: applying Krea's polished aesthetic to an existing image while keeping its composition

edit_use_cases: whole-image img2img: polish/restyle an entire image through Krea 2 Turbo from a prompt, keeping composition
